svg.aria-label: sesmax-core on the GeoStack role ladder: one model step as a pipekit operator; integrate, step, solve_pde and the rollouts as algorithms; the models, forcings, transforms, adapters and test models as models; no strategies of its own, since the solvers are diffrax's and integrix's; the verbs on terms, states and fields as primitives; and the states, terms, bases and domains as structures; monitors, the assimilation libraries and the setup functions sit beside the ladder.
svg.title: sesmax-core on the role ladder
